title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector assistance to address urgent malnutrition in Gorka Woreda, Koore/Amaro Zone, South Ethiopia Region (Priority-1)

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn 2023, the overall humanitarian situation in Ethiopia is remarkably deteriorated. Multiple overlapping humanitarian crises such as ongoing latent conflicts, widespread of violence and climate shocks including prolonged drought and floods, have increased significantly humanitarian needs. The HRP 2024 targets more than 15.5 million people in Ethiopia that are in need of humanitarian assistance. Climate shocks, including drought and floods are still threatening the life of vulnerable people and restricted access to basic needs and services in several zones of the country. ltbrgtThe project targets South Ethiopia region and specifically Gorka Woreda, due to the hughe humanitarian needs caused by the compounded effects of the drought and measle outbreak. The project aims to support drought affected and ongoing outbreak in Gorka woreda, Koore zone (Newly emerged zone), living with limited access to basic services provided from the humanitarian partners and governmental structures. The multi sectoral and integrated response in alignment with the 1stReserve allocation of EHF covers the sectors of Health, Nutrition, Agriculture and WaSH to address needs of returnees and host communities in Gorka woreda. ltbrgtThe integrated intervention will address health needs by focusing on the provision of essential Primary health care services through MHNTs and strengthening system including Maternal and child health, strengthening routine and emergency immunization, support and strengthen surveillance activities and prevention and management of communicable diseases, capacity building of government health care providers, Risk communication and Community engagement, supporting the full functionality of health facilities through provision of medicines and medical supplies, minor health facilities repair and furnishing. The Nutrition section plans to provide lifesaving nutrition interventions by the integration of CMAM and IYCF-E activities through the existing health system. ltbrgtOn another side, the intervention will ensure the access to safe water for 27971 people who will have access to safe drinking water through durable solution ensuring at the same time access to sanitation facilities in institutions such as schools and health facilities, and access to hygiene messaging and improved hygiene practices. This will be enforced by the distribution of WASH-NFI including WTC and hygiene awareness creation. ltbrgtThe Protection mainstreaming across the sector will include risk mitigation, and provision of GBV services, strengthening essential services for survivors of GBV, including case management and psychosocial support services. Whereas the agriculture sector major activities include provision of agricultural inputs, livestock veterinary drugs and multi-purpose cash for the targeted groups. ltbrgtFinally, the project will target 43022 (12,104 Women, 10,617 Girls, 10,100 Men and 10,201 Boys) beneficiaries for the period of 10 months with a total budget of USD 1,000,000.00. ltbrgtlt/pgt
